text: Confirmed and filed approved issue #6544: CTOT rejects VFP9-supported ISO/XML T-separated date-time strings, including fractional seconds and Z suffix. Installed VFP9 Language Reference documents them, COM differential verifies results; current Copperfin public runtime returns typed empty DateTime while legacy control succeeds. https://github.com/rhamenator/Project-Copperfin/issues/6544. No production edit.
